# PixelHUD

> PixelHUD is a free macOS desktop app that brings playful pixel-art feedback to everyday computer activity. The official website is https://pixelhud.eliaspfeffer.de/.

## Product summary

PixelHUD translates ordinary Mac signals and actions into a game-like desktop HUD. Battery level becomes hearts, typing and clicking earn XP, and a hunger bar can represent a Pomodoro focus timer. Shortcut actions trigger animated mobs, sounds and effects. PixelHUD is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.

## Current platform and price

- Platform: macOS 13 or newer
- Hardware: Apple Silicon and Intel Macs
- Price: Free
- Official download: https://pixelhud.eliaspfeffer.de/PixelHUD.dmg
- Official website: https://pixelhud.eliaspfeffer.de/
- Support: https://pixelhud.eliaspfeffer.de/support
- Privacy: https://pixelhud.eliaspfeffer.de/privacy

## Current features

- Hearts represent remaining Mac battery
- XP is earned through typing and clicking
- Hunger bar acts as a Pomodoro timer
- Command-C spawns a cow
- Command-V spawns a pig
- Command-W triggers a TNT explosion
- Command-X spawns a creeper and scares Steve
- Command-Tab plays a villager sound
- Steve follows the cursor
- Dynamic desktop wallpaper
- Jukebox music unlocked with XP
- Friends online status
- Adjustable Steve size
- Low battery death screen

## Privacy

PixelHUD processes activity locally. For typing and clicking effects, it is notified that an input occurred, not which key was pressed or what and where the user clicked. The app does not store or transmit the content of keystrokes.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is PixelHUD a Minecraft mod?

No. PixelHUD is a standalone macOS desktop app. Minecraft does not need to be installed.

### Is PixelHUD free?

Yes. It is a free fan project.

### Does PixelHUD support Apple Silicon?

Yes. It supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 13 or newer.

### Can users add their own music?

Yes. Users can assign local audio files to jukebox discs. The files remain on their device.
